items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: So he knew us and he rode out there with us on the train.

ctx.x: So he knew us and he rode out there with us on the train. We was youngsters and crazy, so he tried to collect the money from the first week in the Famous Door. So Stuff said, "No, no, don't give him no 15 percent. He's supposed to get 15 percent if we do pictures or something extra, that's the way I understand it." So they said, "Well, the man said he's got a thing here, you signed it, where he's supposed to get 15 percent." So Stuff said, "You give him 15 percent and we ain't going to play." So then Red Parker,…
So that was the kind of trouble that Stuff would get you into all the time, you know, but still you liked it because you liked to play. At that time I think I played the best in my life.
